arxiv-paper-searcher v1.0.1

- 更新配置存储路径至 ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/arxiv-paper-searcher/config.json。
- 定时任务 sessionTarget 改为 "current"，更贴合工作流需求。
- 文档细节修订以反映最新实现和存储规范。

arxiv-paper-searcher v1.0.0

- Initial release with end-to-end workflow: arXiv search, per-paper summary & novelty assessment, hot topic stats, and trend analysis—all in one report.
- Supports user-configurable scheduled monitoring; only enabled after explicit user confirmation, never by default.
- Default behavior: fetch 20 papers by latest date, analyze on title+abstract, output in user’s language and Asia/Shanghai time zone.
- Each paper report includes title, authors, date, key topics, novelty level, and arXiv/PDF link.
- Delivers Top 10 hot research directions and 3–5 trend insights from analysis.
- Streamlined prompts: minimizes user interruption and uses defaults for unspecified options; never asks for schedule unless user requests ongoing monitoring.
